Thanks for the context, Emma. I've generated a consolidated invite (attached) that uses demos@redwood.com as the organizer and explicitly cancels the two prior event UIDs. The new .ics includes both the Google Meet link and a Zoom standby URL in the body and the LOCATION field so mail/calendar clients show it prominently.

Attachment: consolidated-invite.ics (text/calendar)

Notes for IT:
- The forwarded invite created a separate ORGANIZER property (organizer+forward@redwood-demo.com) which Google treats as a different mailbox. That produced a reduced ACL on the join URL.
- We've canceled the forwarded-event UID and reissued from demos@redwood.com. If your domain blocks external calendar invites that alter ORGANIZER, please accept the new event or whitelist demos@redwood.com.

I've also opened a support ticket with Zoom (copied) to confirm the Zoom link will remain accessible even if our Meet link is blocked.
